items.title: Cards for your Chinese library
items.line: Connect makes Chinese cards too: pinyin in its tone colours, the sentence's audio and picture.

items.title: hato finds Chinese subtitles
items.line: A Chinese video with no subtitle can go to hato 1.3, on your yes.

items.title: An audiobook's own subtitle lines its book up
items.line: An audiobook that comes with its own timed subtitle lines up its book at once: no long listen first.

items.title: A voice for cards without audio (beta)
items.line: An optional AI voice, off until you install it. It runs on your PC only.

items.title: Ask Piyo about Surasura
items.line: Piyo, in your own AI app, answers how-to questions from this version's guide and looks at what's wrong.

items.title: A book card's sentence holds its word
items.line: The sentence that holds the word, within your Length, never a page-long speech.

items.title: The narrator's voice on older book cards
items.line: Book cards made before the audiobook was lined up can get its clip (from the command line for now).

items.title: 順 finishes a cut-off reorder
items.line: A reorder you start finishes an automatic one that was cut off; one Undo puts back both.

items.title: A subtitle that shifts part-way is re-timed
items.line: Another broadcast's cut no longer leaves an episode Not timed.

items.title: A line near a cut never makes a card
items.line: Where the timing is unsure the word takes another line, or waits.

items.title: Words split more truly
items.line: という runs on to the line it names; an unknown name like 犍陀多 is one word.
